intro: Angola has a long Atlantic coast, a high central plateau and the Namib Desert in the south.

chapters.title: Land
text: The Kalandula Falls are among Africa's largest waterfalls. The Okavango and Zambezi rivers rise in the eastern highlands. Cabinda, an oil-rich exclave, lies north of the Congo River.

chapters.title: Wildlife
text: The giant sable antelope, found only in Angola, was once thought extinct.

keyTerms.meaning: Land separated from the main country.
